relevance.rationale: Genuine orphan. The document bigrades the Hopf algebra of undecorated rooted trees and its two closed Hopf subalgebras (the cocommutative ladder subalgebra and the Connes-Moscovici noncocommutative subalgebra) by node number and degree of primitivity, computing dimensions via iterated coproducts and proving saturation of the inequalities using the universal Hochschild-closed one-cocycle B_+. This is perturbative-QFT renormalization combinatorics. Corpus-grep: 'rooted tree' appears once in the whole repo, in fsh-guts/deprecated/docs/audits/2026-05-05-r-and-kite-tails-exploration.md — a deprecated exploration; 'renormaliz' in content/ appears only as Moebius-energy renormalization (rem:mobius-surreal-renormalization) and a colour-scale renormalization in a falsifiability table, neither of which is the Connes-Kreimer object. The folio's Hopf algebras are the Drinfeld-Jimbo quantum group and def:frobenius-hopf-substrate, and it has no perturbative expansion in Feynman diagrams for this machinery to grade. Same broad field (Hopf algebras in physics), no result this folio can consume. Scope-(a): this document, as read, supplies nothing usable here — not a claim that Connes-Kreimer methods are irrelevant to the folio in principle.

proposedActions.rationale: No block, Lean declaration or script in the folio consumes a rooted-tree Hopf algebra or a renormalization coproduct; registering it would create a bibliography entry with no citation site.
